title: Residual takeoff contact must not reset jump state
task_type: Unity Editor asset and build verification
environment: Observed Unity controller and intended jump rules. Different physics/contact models need their own transition contract and timing tests.
goal: Enforce a two-jump budget through takeoff, ascent and landing.
approach: Historical failed assumption: Any ground contact was interpreted as a landing event.
what_worked: Historical correction: Exclude immediate post-takeoff contact from landing reset in this controller. Verification reported by the source: An editor driver injected keyboard state through actual Input Actions and observed jump, second jump and fall after correction. A dedicated timing unit test was not recorded for this exact defect.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Brief ground contact during ascent reset the jump count.
why: Confirmed in the tested controller: contact persisted briefly after takeoff and triggered the reset at the wrong lifecycle phase.
improved_method: Treat landing as a state transition supported by contact and motion/timing, not raw contact alone. Regress takeoff persistence through the actual input path.
when_to_use: Observed Unity controller and intended jump rules. Different physics/contact models need their own transition contract and timing tests.
when_not_to_use: Do not extrapolate outside the recorded conditions or use partial evidence to claim general product or release acceptance.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
